scope: Estimate + coarse family + Mth-power refinement + fine PSK classification (bpsk/qpsk) + symbol-rate estimation, gated to continuous candidates within their validated SNR ranges.

methods.refinement: separate full-segment-length Hann periodogram Mth-power peak with log-parabolic interpolation
methods.coarse: existing 257-tap band isolation; 128-sample edge trim; envelope coefficient of variation
methods.bandwidth: raw averaged in-band PSD; connected interpolated half-power lobe; shortest whole-bin 99% power band
methods.fine: Mth-power phase-cluster circular spread < 0.8 rad on continuous candidates only; excludes pulsed bursts
methods.symbol_rate: differentiate+square nonlinearity, Welch PSD, lowest bin within 3 dB of peak excluding the first 4 DC-leakage bins; gated to a confirmed fine PSK label and >=4.5 dB SNR
